newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Dealers see Swedish crown strengthening vs mark.
newsitem.headline: Dealers see Swedish crown strengthening vs mark.

text.p: The Swedish crown has a good chance of strengthening further, nearing the 4.30 level against the mark by the end of the year, dealers said on Monday.
But for the time being political factors, such as fears that the Swedish government is wavering on budget consolidation moves, will brake further gains in the Swedish crown.
"Actually the Swedish crown should have already broken the 4.35 level against the mark if you look at the dollar and other currencies," HSBC economist Peter Lindqvist told Reuters.
Lindqvist said the crown would reach the level 4.31 to 4.32 against the mark before the turn of the year.
At the midsession on Monday the crown was trading at 4.35 crowns to the mark.

S-E-Banken's chief economist Klaes Eklund, in a market newsletter, accused the government of wavering and referred to proposals to increase capital tax and postpone reforming regulations for jobless benefits and pension payments.
Net savings through the reform of unemployment payments are expected to save the state 693 million crowns alone.
"It is unusual that the parliament is tearing up decisions which have already been made," Eklund said.
Swedbank economist Knut Hallberg said the crown has the potential to strengthen to 4.30 mark in a longer term.
"The fundamentals look good with a strong trade balance and very low inflation," Hallberg said.
